author: Inside Edition
description: The eldest son of famed director Rob Reinder and wife Michelle is breaking his silence four months after their murders, allegedly at the hands of their son Nick. Nick has pled not guilty to the charges. "It's too devastating to comprehend. I still wake up every morning having to convince myself that, no, it's not a dream. This truly is my living nightmare," Jake Reiner says. He published an essay Friday titled "Mom and Dad: The Center of My Life."
title: Rob And Michelle Reiner's Eldest Son Breaks His Silence

author: Inside Edition
description: A toddler stole the show in the Oval Office. Two-year-old Travis Smith rolled around the plush carpet and charmed the commander-in-chief with his antics. At 6 months, Smith was deaf. The family learned about a new experimental gene therapy from Regeneron, where genetically altered genes are injected deep into the ears. His mother says within around three months, the boy was hearing. They were part of the president's affordable healthcare press conference.
title: 2-Year-Old Steals The Show At White House Press Conference

author: Inside Edition
description: There is fury after a teacher at an elite all-girls private boarding school in Massachusetts was accused of raping two teenaged girls. 64-year-old Matt Rutledge was a history teacher at Miss Hall's School, where tuition is now $83,000 a year. After pleading not guilty, Rutledge was released without having to post bail. Now in their 30s, Melissa Fares and Hilary Simon tell Inside Edition what they say happened when they were teenagers at the school.
title: Fury As Teacher Accused Of Raping 2 Teen Students

author: Inside Edition
description: Authorities in Washington state waded through rising water to rescue a double amputee who became stranded in a hammock during high tide on April 21. Kitsap County Sheriff’s Office says that the man had fallen asleep and was unable to put on his prosthetic legs as the water rose around him. Even police needed help as a small launch from a Washington State Ferry was later used to transport the victim after officers were unable to safely carry him out.
title: Washington Authorities Rescue Double Amputee Stuck In Hammock Over River

author: Inside Edition
description: At 113 years old, Sister Francis Piscatella is very wise. She's had more days to learn than most of us. One of the more important lessons she said she's picked up during a lifetime of service is that perfection isn't necessary for a good life. A Sister of Saint Dominic based in New York, Piscatella is believed to be the oldest nun in the world, as well as the oldest person in the state. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Oldest Nun In The World Turns 113 In New York
